_: The model ladder, as data. Nothing here is compiled into code.
`shown` is what the agent calls itself in its own opening event, and it is
the only trustworthy answer to what actually ran: asking for a model is not
the same as getting one, and effort suffixes have been dropped silently.
Two traps live in this table. Rank 4 reports itself as `Cursor Grok 4.6`
with no effort word in it at all, and that string is a prefix of every
other Grok 4.6 row here. Across the 214 models this account can see there
are 197 such prefix pairs. So a `shown` is compared by exact equality,
never by prefix and never by substring.
Regenerate with `node scripts/models.mjs sync`, which reads
`agent --list-models` and refuses if an id has stopped existing.
